GHA.note: The advisory warns of deepfakes and says the CSA works with platforms to remove them, but cites no rule, mandate or dated takedown.
No government use of AI is stated.
No AI tool in a sector system is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in Ghana is stated.

facts.fact: The Cyber Security Authority's CERT-GH issued public advisory CSA/CERT/MPA/2025-06/01 on 30 June 2025 warning of AI-generated deepfake videos promoting fake investments and drugs.
